newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-COACH STEPS DOWN AFTER HITTING PLAYER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-COACH STEPS DOWN AFTER HITTING PLAYER.

text.p: Casino Graz coach Ljubo Petrovic has resigned after hitting a player in the dressing room, club secretary Karl-Heinz Koritnig said on Wednesday.
Koritnig said Petrovic had assaulted forward Boban Dmitrovic after Casinon Graz lost 3-1 to Belgium's Germinal Ekeren in their UEFA Cup first round first leg match on Tuesday.
Dmitrovic was sent off in the 50th minute.
"It was agreed by both sides that he (Petrovic) should step down," Koritnig said.
Petrovic has been replaced by assistant coach Hans-Peter Schaller.
